# RC45 — Select current line or selected-line block

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc L` / `core.select-lines` / `Select Line/Selection`.
- The command selects the current logical line when there is no active selection.
- When a partial selection already exists, it expands the selection to the full affected logical-line range.
- Follow-up line commands such as duplicate, delete, move, indent, and outdent can now start from a stable whole-line selection without relying on precise Shift-arrow selection in Blink/iPad keyboard routing.
- The action footer, command palette, keymap reference, README action table, and iPad QA route now expose the command.
- Hardened the Git commit picker filter test so its fuzzy-filter assertion no longer depends on random commit hash characters during parallel full-suite runs.
